_about: Passages that gospel synopses print side by side although Robertson's harmony places them on different occasions (whether these are one teaching or event told in different settings, or similar words on more than one occasion, is the judgement call; the reader shows both and decides nothing). Each set: the first passage pairs with each of the others, and each of the others links back to it. The pairings follow the traditional KJV 'Harmony of the Gospels' chart the user supplied on 20 Oct 2026. Checked by scripts/validate.mjs: the verses exist and each pair sits in different rows.
